mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_message ( conversation_id, sender_id, sender_type, content, message_type, extra_info, send_time, is_read, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{senderType}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{extraInfo}, NOW(), 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT cm.id AS messageId, cm.sender_id AS senderId, u.name AS senderName, cm.send_time AS sendTime, cm.is_read, cm.message_type, cm.content, cm.extra_info AS extraInfo FROM conversation_message cm LEFT JOIN user_info u ON cm.sender_id = u.id WHERE cm.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND cm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cm.send_time ASC
